# **Theosis — RPG Progression (Apotheosis for Servers)**

**Theosis** is the ultimate plugin reinterpretation of the *Apotheosis* mod. It brings a deep RPG progression experience to your server **without any mods, while fully preserving the vanilla essence**.

The gameplay loop is highly addictive: **better loot ➔ stronger builds ➔ harder bosses ➔ greater rewards**. Everything is fully optimized for servers and 100% configurable.

**NOTE:**
_The plugin works with **Spigot, Paper, and Purpur**.
**However, Paper or Purpur are recommended**, as some perks may not function correctly in Spigot (due to technical limitations)._

---

## ⚙️ Plugin Modules

The plugin is divided into independent modules that you can easily toggle on or off in the configuration:

### ⚔️ `perks: true` (Item Skills)

All tools and armor pieces can receive unique advantages (**perks**) that grant special abilities. There are over **100 unique skills** distributed across all equipment types in the game!
![Perks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11ed1042140d6b5e14c115494d94c8567e14bccc.png)!

---
### 💎 `gems: true` (Gem System)

Players can find sockets and gems within the loot from towers. Gems feature 3 purity levels:


# Level I ➔ Level II ➔ Level III
![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db7d770b4c2876952766f8c8dcbe04a4edc2914b.png)
![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4237daff6a8f588271202dc7cbddb2a38eccb84f.png)


* **Upgrading:** You can upgrade a gem's tier by combining two gems of the same level inside an anvil (e.g., combining two Level I gems creates a Level II gem).
* **Socketing:** These gems can be fused into any weapon or armor piece with open slots (*sockets*) using an anvil. This process costs experience and inflicts wear on the anvil.

### 🏰 `structures: true` (Structures)

Enables the generation of custom towers featuring dimension-specific loot tables. **The tougher the dimension, the better the rewards.**

![Towers](https://res.cloudinary.com/dhgdy73up/image/upload/v1782243052/Torreesjuntas_um6uxs.png)
---

### 👑 `bosses: true` (Boss Encounters)

Bosses are categorized by dimension, and their stats scale dynamically based on the tier of the player fighting them:

* **Overworld:** `SLIME`, `SKELETON`, `ZOMBIE`, `PILLAGER`, `WITCH`
* **Nether:** `WITHER_SKELETON`, `BLAZE`, `WITCH`, `ENDERMAN`
* **End:** `SHULKER`, `ENDERMAN`

![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc655dd697ca072a2cdf7ca2490ea3a54201b058.png)

---

### 📊 `tiers: true` (Progression Tiers)

This module introduces a player-tier system to manage difficulty scaling across the server:

* **Tier 1:** The starting level. Bosses are at their weakest.
* **Tier 2:** Automatically unlocked when a player equips at least 3 armor pieces with a rarity of `COMMON`, `UNCOMMON`, or `RARE`.
* **Tier 3:** Unlocked upon traveling to the Nether.
* **Tier 4:** Unlocked after defeating the Wither or the Ender Dragon.
* **Tier 5:** The ultimate tier. Achieved by equipping an item with `MYTHIC` rarity.

---

### 👹 `variants: true` (Mob Variants)

Allows vanilla mobs to spawn as elite variants equipped with unique combat mechanics. There are **9 available variants**:

* **Brute Creeper:** Doesn't know how to detonate, so it charges forward to attack you with melee strikes.
* **Enderman Warp:** Teleports you randomly upon hitting you.
* **Zombie Venom:** Inflicts a poison effect whenever it lands a hit.
* **Phantom Grabber:** Snatches you up, flies high into the air, and drops you from above.
* **Spider Web Trapper:** Traps you in a cobweb for 1 to 2 seconds during combat.
* **Spider Brood:** Spawns a cluster of baby spiders upon death.
* **Arcane Archer:** A smarter, deadlier skeleton equipped with a magical bow.
* **Mummified Leader:** Spawns exclusively in desert biomes. Striking it causes it to summon reinforcing minions.
* **Wither Knight:** Launches you vertically into the air on hit and deals significantly higher Wither damage than normal.
 
---

### 📚 `enchant_library: true` (Arcane Library)

A specialized utility structure that allows you to store, centralize, and boost your enchantments far beyond vanilla limitations.

* **Crafting:** Crafted using *Eyes of Ender*, a *Nether Star*, and a *Barrel*.
* **Activation:** The barrel must be completely surrounded by bookshelves (either standard or chiseled) to activate.
* **Mechanics:** Deposit your duplicate enchanted books to accumulate "Power Points" for that specific enchantment. For instance, storing multiple *Sharpness IV* books will let you extract a single book with a superior tier, such as **Sharpness VII**.

You can now create Arcane Tomes from Arcane Dust.

Recipe:

- D.D.D

• Extracts approximately 50% of enchantments.

## 🔧 Anvil Support System

A configurable cost system has been added for the anvil.

Several predefined configurations are available, allowing server administrators to decide the cost of using the anvil.

![Reemplaza esto con una descripción](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f5fe59ddb2374a4a3862d0a9793cdfa651d6d50e.png)

Everything can be configured directly in **config.yml**.

## 🔍 Gameplay Overview

### Build Customization

Every tool and armor piece drops with random perks and an unpredictable number of sockets. Combined with base attack/defense stats and item rarity, this guarantees that every piece of loot found in your world feels entirely unique.

There are **25 distinct types of gems**, each offering a specific attribute. Players must carefully match the right gem type with the corresponding equipment to successfully activate its effects.

### Smart Boss Spawning

Bosses spawn dynamically throughout the world at a safe distance, giving players the choice to engage in the encounter or avoid it entirely. An on-screen boss health bar reflects the boss's tier color, letting players instantly know exactly what level of threat they are facing.

---

## 📌 Admin Commands

### Boss & Gem Management

* `/theosis boss spawn [player]` — Spawns a custom boss near the targeted player.
* `/theosis boss clear [all]` — Instantly clears active bosses.
* `/theosis gem [gem_name]` — Grants a specific gem type.
* `/theosis perk` — Manually applies random perks to the item currently held in your hand.

### UI Menus & Core System

* `/theosis hub` — Opens an interactive GUI menu to easily apply/remove perks and manage gems visually. *(A friendly alternative to typing individual commands)*.
* `/theosis reload` — Reloads all `.yml` configuration files.

### Tier Management

* `/theosistier add [player]` — Promotes a player's progression tier.
* `/theosistier clear [player]` — Resets a player's progression tier to default.
* `/theosistier get [player]` — Displays a player's current progression level.
* `/theosistier set/lock/unlock` — Adjusts, locks, or unlocks specific tier progression paths.
